user.title: Salzburg Netz smart meter
user.description: Create an API key in the Salzburg Netz service portal (Kundenkonto → Mein Benutzerkonto → API Schlüssel). The first download happens within a minute, then every day at 11:40.

reconfigure.title: New Salzburg Netz API key
reconfigure.description: Paste a new key from the Salzburg Netz service portal.

error.invalid_gpnr: The customer number has 8 digits and starts with 1.
error.invalid_zp: The metering point has 33 characters and starts with AT00 (or is a 10-digit installation number starting with 003).
error.invalid_key: That doesn't look like a complete API key.

abort.already_configured: This metering point is already set up.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The new API key is saved.
